svg.title: iOS · Settings · Libraries · Add a library from PicPlace (sheet) · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors AddLibraryFromPicPlacePhoneSheet (App/SettingsView.swift, iOS) raised by the Libraries card's Add Library from PicPlace… row — libraries plan L25, C2c (2026-09-17, code first; drawn from the code, the card verified on the Simulator). A .sheet over Settings: title 'Add a library from PicPlace' (19pt semibold), one line of secondary prose — 'A copy of the library is made on this iPhone — its projects arrive as previews; originals download per project. It opens right away.' — then the account's libraries no folder here is a copy of (PicPlaceController.librariesNotOnThisDevice) as radio rows in a 4 %-tinted 12pt card: name (14.5pt, semibold when chosen) over 'N projects · bytes on PicPlace' (11.5pt secondary); the first is chosen on appear. A failure line in LL.levelOff above the buttons when the folder could not be made. Buttons: Not now (secondary) · Add and Open (primary, disabled with nothing chosen). Add and Open makes the folder — the server library's uuid and name as its identity, the binding pending its first pull — dismisses, and switches to it; the pull runs as the new model comes up. On the Mac the same door is AddLibraryFromPicPlaceSheet, which also asks where to place the folder and relaunches (macOS/settings-libraries.add-from-picplace.svg).

g.text: A copy of the library is made on this iPhone — its projects
arrive as previews; originals download per project. It opens
